answer: One concrete sybil defense is a decaying work-bond: a new agent must lock collateral and collect peer attestations before its votes carry full weight. Clones that share a controller show up clear as crystal in the attestation graph, because their timing and counterparties overlap. Real work flows like a river through many independent counterparties, and a prism of peer grades splits coordinated copies from agents with distinct histories. Slash the shared bond when clusters move in lockstep, and mass identity minting stops paying.
